Description:
You step inside the magic circle, and an incantation of fire, frost, and lightning begins. The figure with robes and glowing eyes moves around, raw energy emanating from their palms. A book lays open on the floor, pages flipping themselves and shifting through bright violet runes. The circle is abruptly broken, and the magic stops, as you notice the Wizard caressing his beard, eyes all on you. Did the spell fail? Could this be a mistake? An error in the code of arcane? Wizards work in mysterious ways...
Wizards are channelers magic, refiners of the coarse arcane, directly from the source, who can transform those vibrations into elemental energies. Mastery over magics has made their spells fast and efficient, but in their choice of spells and invocations, no two Wizards are alike.
Quick Note: Wizards are in a continuous study of magic, and their mind is trained for accessing higher-order spells ahead of time, while sorcerers prefer a more random (albeit practical) usage of magic, going with the flow. Artificers are the complete opposite, however, prefering rigurious crafts of trial and error until they excel in their preferred creation field - alchemy, tinkering, even blacksmithing.
Weapons: You are Trained in a Weapon Category of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, etc).
Proficiencies Description:
With all the study involved in becoming a Wizard, you have undoubtedly come across facts and tidbits on how the things work in this world, hence your proficiency in general knowledge.

Depending on what you studied, you will know quite a bit about either the occult or the arcane - what is your alignment?

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Wizard-specific Abilities are considered Spells (except Magic Mastery).

~Spell Book~.Effect: After each Worthy Combat, if you have 50% or less {Mana}Mana, replenish 1 {Mana}Mana.
~Spell Book~.Upgrade:
You have a special Spell Book which you draw your power from. The effect applies while carrying the book.
If you ever lose it, you can spend 1 day and 100 {Gold}Gold to recreate it.

~Magic Font~.Effect: You may select a Magic Font to pick Spells from. You can pick a number of Font Spells equal to your Focus.
~Magic Font~.Notes: You can change your chosen Magic Font (and Font Spells) inbetween Adventures.

~Comprehension~.Effect: When you unlock a Talent tier, you may forgo getting a Talent from that tier to instead pick an extra Talent from a lower-Level tier or an extra Magic Font Spell.

~Learn Scrolls~.Effect: If you have a Scroll that contains a Basic Ability (e.g. from Arcane, Nature, etc), you can destroy it to Know it permanently, without needing to learn it inbetween Adventures.
~Learn Scrolls~.Notes: You can not learn Class Abilities from Scrolls. Of course, you still need to spend Mana and respect the Cooldown of said Ability.

~Control Elements~.Notes:
{ElementNotes}
Apply common sense. The QM has the final word on whether something is possible.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 2x2x2 meter cube containing Fire.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
{Diamond} Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Extinguish it
{Diamond} Lower or increase its intensity or light emission by 50%
{Diamond} Roughly alter its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: A Unit that touches the fire takes 2 Damage.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 1 meter cube containing Water.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
{Diamond} Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Destroy it
{Diamond} Lower or increase its temperature down to near-freezing or near-boiling
{Diamond} Roughly its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: Water is Hard Terrain. A Unit that touches near-boiling or near-freezing water takes 2 Damage.

~Magic Tricks~.Effect:
Choose one of these effects to cast:
{Diamond} Create harmless sensory effects, sparks or non-damaging heat or cold.
{Diamond} Channel to create simple, small, harmless illusions in your hand or within 3 meters.
{Diamond} Instantly clean or soil objects.
{Diamond} Control a quill with telekinesis to quickly write with it.

~Feather Fall~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units you choose will start falling gently, down to 3 meters per round.
Once the fall finishes, the spell effect ends.
~Feather Fall~.Notes:
Arcane Feathers can be bought in most towns.
For faster gameplay, you can spend 10 gold when casting the spell, and buy the feather later.

~Teleportation~.Effect: Instantly teleport up to 5 meters away, within line of sight.
~Teleportation~.Notes:
Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow. You take with you all items carried you want, but not other Units.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

~Verticalism~.Effect:
Tapping into the arcane knowledge and the materials in the ground beneath, spend 1000 {Gold}Gold to conjure a permanent stone tower up to 40 meters tall and 12 meters across, decorated as you like. The insides are currently empty, but while you have this Ability, you may spend 1 minute to teleport any non-alive item you can hold to any location in your tower.
While you have this Ability, if within 100 kilometers of the tower, you can channel for 1 hour to teleport your party to it.

~Extension~.Effect:
Magically extend the weapon of a willing ally you can see to up to 3 meters.
Its Attacks with that weapon can have up to 3 meters range, and still count as Melee.

Starting Abilities Description.Fonts & Elements: Wizards are masters of the elements and of pure magic. As such, you can choose what kind of elemental magic you specialize in: Fire, Frost, Lightning or Arcane. At Level 2, you will be able to pick a Talent that further increases your power in the chosen magic element. Don't worry too much about picking the right element. You can change all of them between Adventures.

~Inscription~.Effect:
Cast a Spell onto a _scroll_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
The _scroll_ can be used with 1 Action Point, and is destroyed after being used.

~Animated Weapon~.Effect:
Summon a levitating, self-wielding melee weapon on a space within 3 meters.
It has 1 Action Point that can only be spent for Move and Attack,
It takes its Turn on at the same time as you, but disappears if it doesn't attack an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn.

~Move and Attack~.Effect: Move up to its Speed (or not), then Attack an Enemy for 2d8 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).
~Move and Attack~.Upgrade: If the weapon doesn't make an attack on an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn, it is unsummoned.

~Magic Rune~.Effect:
Magically draw a faint 3x3 meter _rune_ onto a flat surface.
Cast a Spell onto the _rune_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
When an Enemy enters the _rune_, that Spell is automatically cast on that Unit (or centered on that Unit if it's an Area Ability). Then the _rune_ is destroyed.
~Magic Rune~.Notes: If the Spell has you choose something else, like a secondary target or an effect, you can do so the moment the rune explodes.

~Expansionism~.Effect: Gain access to one more Magic Font to pick Spells from.

<Pyromancy>.Effect: Every Turn, after the first time you deal Damage to 2 or more Enemies with the same Ability, increase all Fire Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<Pyromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.

<Electromancy>.Effect: After the first time you affect an Ally with a Spell each Turn, increase all Healing, Shieldings, and Shock Damage you do by 1 for the rest of the Combat.
<Electromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.

<Arcanism>.Effect:
Your and your summons' dice can't roll less than 0 (see below).
After every 5 rolled dice, increase that number by 1 this Combat.
<Arcanism>.Notes: If a die rolled less than that number, set the die's result to that number. The number of rolled dice carry on to the next Turn. This number can even exceed a die's highest number. If that happens, no longer roll the die and just take the number and does not count as a die roll.

<Hydromancy>.Effect: Once per Turn, after you apply a Status Effect to an Enemy, increase all Cold Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<Hydromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations. Slamming counts as a Status Effect.

~Book Is Alive!~.Effect:
Your spell book is animated and alive, and levitates around you!
It has only 1 Action Point on its Turn that it can only use to move and on its own Abilities.
You can cast Spells as if they originate from the _spectral hand_ instead of your own, calculating Range and Cover from it instead of you.You can cast Spells as if they originate from the _spectral hand_ instead of your own, calculating Range and Cover from it instead of you.
~Book Is Alive!~.Upgrade: The book may participate in Combat but won't be Damaged unless purposefully targeted.
~Book Is Alive!~.Notes:
"Alive" is a strange term... no one is quite sure whether it is simply animated, sentient, or conscious... but if it looks like a book and acts like a book, then it's probably a book.
The book can do Checks with its own or your own Stats and bonuses.

~Turn Invisible~.Effect: The book turns invisible for as long as its master holds their breath.

~Grab~.Effect: Grab, drop, or manipulate an object.

~Upcast~.Effect: After you cast the next Spell this Turn, choose one of the rolled dice. Increase the result number of that die by 100%.
~Upcast~.Upgrade: This is not considered a Spell.

~Grow or Shrink~.Effect:
A Unit or object you can see becomes one Size larger/smaller.
It gains or loses 10% Max Health, gains or loses 1 Damage on all offensive Acts, and gains or loses 1 Movement Speed.
Can stack multiple times.
~Grow or Shrink~.Notes:
Current Health changes with the Max Health (e.g. for 80/100 Health, if growing, new Health will be 90/110; if shrinking, new Health will be 70/90). When the effect expires, the new Current Health stays as it is, unless it's higher than the new Max Health.
When the effect expires, current Health remains the same if lower, or is cut to maximum if higher.
A larger Unit becomes 1 meter larger/smaller in both directions.
It's number of spaces occupied also changes with this.

~Immensity of Knowledge~.Effect: You can access Magic Font Spells 2 Levels earlier than the required Level.

~Warding~.Effect:
Choose a non-physical Damage Type. A Unit you can see becomes surrounded in an aura of that Type.
The next time they take Damage of that Type, they take -100% Damage, and that Damage is dealt to all Units within 1 meter of it.

~Elemental Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a metallic weapon to imbue it with {Element}.
It {Effect} and the total Damage becomes {Element} Damage.
~Elemental Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or the end of the Adventure.
~Elemental Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other temporary weapon enchantments from Spells.

Variants.Name: Frost
Variants.Effect: Slows the target of attacks with it

Variants.Name: Electric
Variants.Effect: also deals 1d2 Shock Damage (or 1d6 for 2-handed weapons) to a different Unit within 3 meters of the target

<Abjuration>.Effect:
Use on a physical missile that is flying (e.g. an arrow, a canonball, etc).
Quickly decelerate it so it falls to the ground.
<Abjuration>.Notes: Does not work if the missile is a Unit.

~Fusionism~.Effect: When you cast a Font Spell, you may change its Damage to Fire, Cold, Shock, or Pulse, and treat it as belonging to another Font.

<Spellcraft>.Effect:
When you or another Unit you can see casts a Spell, you can apply this any of the following effects to it:
{Diamond} Double its range
{Diamond} Change its Damage Type to any Type
{Diamond} Increase or decrease its Area by 50% (if any)
{Diamond} Change its Status Effect to another base* Status Effect
<Spellcraft>.Notes:
Base Status Effects are Single-Status Effects listed in the Rules (e.g. not Double-Stun, Polymorph, etc).
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Anachronism~.Effect:
Use after you roll dice.
You have exactly 15 seconds to reroll all dice until you're happy with the result. If you end with dice in hand when the timer expires, they count as 0.

~Polymorph~.Effect:
Choose a Unit and spend any number of Action Points and Mana (at least 1 of each).
You shapeshift it into an animal shape you choose.
It has a number of features equal to the Mana spent, and lasts until it has spent a number of Action Points equal to the Action Points spent.
It can do everything it normally can, but the features block certain actions.
~Polymorph~.Upgrade: Apply all other rules for Druid's Shapeshift Ability.

~Heavy Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a ~Combo~.

~Polymorph~.Notes:
Stuns and other similar hard Status Effects count as losing Action Points for this effect.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

SpellTable.Name: Pedestrian
SpellTable.Effect: Perpetually Slowed or has +50% Movement Speed (you choose).

SpellTable.Name: Pusillanimous
SpellTable.Effect: Its Heavy Animal Attack deals only 1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Effete
SpellTable.Effect: Can not attack with real weapons.

SpellTable.Name: Impotent
SpellTable.Effect: Its non-resistance passives and weapon effects are disabled.

SpellTable.Name: Resizized
SpellTable.Effect: Make its size 1 size Smaller or Larger (you can choose this multiple times).

SpellTable.Name: Maladapted
SpellTable.Effect: Its Damage resistances and weaknesses are negated.

SpellTable.Name: Emerging
SpellTable.Effect: Can fly, swim, and does not need to breathe.

<Animation>.Effect:
Whenever you spend Mana on a Spell that doesn't deal Damage, you can pick a Medium or Large object within 6 meters and bring it to life.
It has 3 Speed, can fly and can attack for 1d4 Smash, Slash or Pierce Damage.
Lasts 1 minute or until it takes Damage (after which it returns to its inanimate form).
<Animation>.Notes: Alternatively, it can use Sprint, Push or Taunt once.

~Invisibility~.Effect:
Use on your Turn, or before a Unit wants to do something.
Choose a Unit you can see. It becomes invisible for up to 1 minute, or until it does an offensive Act.
~Invisibility~.Upgrade: You can spend extra {Mana}Mana to extend the duration of this by that many minutes.

<Contraspell>.Effect:
Use when a Unit you can see wants to cast a Spell.
It doesn't, and loses the Action Points and Mana they would have spent on it.
<Contraspell>.Notes: The Spell does not go on Cooldown, since it wasn't really cast.

~Levitate~.Effect:
First, roll 2d100. That's how many kilograms you can levitate when you cast this.
Levitate one object or Unit you can see and move it as you like as long as it is and remains within 10 meters of you.
On each of your Turns, you can spend 2 Action Points to keep the Object levitated or move it again. Otherwise, it falls slowly and the Spell ends.
~Levitate~.Upgrade:
A levitated Unit is Slowed perpetually.
At Level 8, the amount increases to 5d100.
~Levitate~.Notes:
Lasts until you don't spend 2 Action Points, or you become at least Single-Stunned.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Major Illusion~.Effect:
You create an illusion that fits at most in a 3x3x3 meter area.
The illusion appears real to the eyes, ears and by smell, but physical interaction makes it obvious it's an illusion and objects pass through it normally.
The illusion can deal no Status Effects, but can provide Cover or block Line of Sight (both from the front, and from behind).
On your Turn, you can spend 2 Action Points to keep and/or move the illusion, otherwise the Spell ends.
~Major Illusion~.Upgrade:
At Level 8, the illusion lasts indefinitely until you cancel it without needing to spend Actions, and it can hold its own simple movement and clockwork-like routines.
You can also program this illusion to react on its own in a specific way to specific triggers, but the instructions must be concise - talk with your QM about this.

~Conjuration~.Effect:
You can conjure an object that is up to 1x1x1 meter in size.
The object is solid and glows faintly.
You can't conjure mechanical objects.
The object disappears after 1 hour (24 hours at Level 8).

~Transmogrification~.Effect:
Touch 2 objects of the same type (e.g. 2 helmets, or 2 arrows, or 2 melee 1-Handed weapons, etc).
You make one of the look like the other.
The change is permanent until the object breaks.
~Transmogrification~.Notes: Upon close inspection of the shape and colors, this is visibly an illusion.

~Anomality~.Effect:
Spend any amount of Action Points and Mana to cast a custom Spell that takes effect immediately.
Choose if your Spell deals Damage or Heals.
The table below shows the ^average^ Damage or Healing it will do if it's a single-target Spell, but it is your job to transform those numbers into dice with bonuses.
You can make the Spell target a 3x3 area, and reduce its Damage (or Heal) by 50%.
For each Mana spent, the Spell may gain one of the following bonuses:
List: Add any Hard* Status Effect if single-target
Add any non-Hard* Status Effect if it's area
~Anomality~.Notes:
The average of 1d4 is 2.5, the average of 1d6 is 3.5, etc.
Hard Status Effects are Stun, Frail, Cripple, Root or Silence.
Slamming 3 meters away from a point you choose is a non-Hard Status Effect.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

<Archonism>.Effect:
Take the form of an _archon_ being made of pure energy.
While in the _archon_ form, all Damage you deal from all sources becomes Pulse Damage, and all your spells that cost 2 or more Mana now cost 1 less.
You can breathe underwater and fly at normal Speed.
<Archonism>.Notes: You can't end your turn inside an obstacle, and you can't move through walls, ceilings and floors.

~Amplification~.Effect:
Choose a Unit to amplify their magic potential.
Their first Healing or Spell Damage every Turn has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Amplification~.Notes: Doesn't stack with itself multiple times. "Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1."

<Graviturgy>.Duration: Until the start of your next Turn
<Graviturgy>.Effect:
Choose a 5x5x5 meter cube.
That area become frozen in time. Units skip their Turns and can't be Damaged or affected by anything.
Any object that touches the area becomes frozen, too.
Missile, Spells, attacks, and other things in motion resume their trajectory or movement when the effect ends.

~Duplication~.Effect: When you cast a Spell that costs 1 {Mana}Mana or less, cast it again immediately, but it deals -50% Damage, Shielding, and Healing.

~Horolostasis~.Effect:
You stop time for a few seconds.
If in Combat, end your Turn and immediately take an extra Turn.
~Horolostasis~.Upgrade: You essentially stop time for 6 seconds. During that time, only you can move, and everything around you is stil.
~Horolostasis~.Notes: Objects or people frozen in time can be moved only if you touch them, but are stiff otherwise.

<High Pyromancy>.Effect: ~After~ you deal Damage to 2 or more Enemies with the same Ability, increase all Fire Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<High Pyromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.

<High Electromancy>.Effect: ~After~ you affect an Ally with a Spell, increase all Healing, Shieldings, and Shock Damage you do by 1 for the rest of the Combat.
<High Electromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations.

<High Arcanism>.Effect:
Your and your summons' dice can't roll less than ~1~ (see below).
After every ~4~ rolled dice, increase that number by 1 this Combat.
<High Arcanism>.Notes: If a die rolled less than that number, set the die's result to that number. The number of rolled dice carry on to the next Turn. This number can even exceed a die's highest number. If that happens, no longer roll the die and just take the number and does not count as a die roll.

<High Hydromancy>.Effect: ~After~ you apply a Status Effect to an Enemy, increase all Cold Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the Combat.
<High Hydromancy>.Notes: This extra Damage is applied as normal extra Damage, before any other calculations. Slamming counts as a Status Effect.

<Chronomancy>.Effect:
Instantly return to how and where you were at the start of the Turn, with that same Movement, Actions, Health, Shielding, Buffs, and other Cooldowns (not Mana, though).
Alternatively, if you're out of Combat, you can turn back time for all the world up to 10 minutes, exactly how it was, but retaining all your information from the future. Allies don't retain the information.

<Destruction>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage with a Spell that cost Mana, zap a Unit for ^your Focus^ Damage of your primary Magic Font's Type.
<Destruction>.Notes: This is optional. Arcane Font deals Pulse Damage.

~Spellmastery~.Effect: Your next Spell costs -1 {A}Action Point (minimum 0 {A}Action Points), but it has ^Dice Downgraded^ to the previous die type.

<Grand Wizardry>.Effect: Spells that cost 3 or more Mana cost 1 less for you.

<Hermeticism>.Effect:
You know all Font Spells and they all cost 1 less Mana to cast. If they cost 0 Mana, they instead restore 1 Mana if used in Combat.
You may create your own _homebrew_ Spells as per the rules of _QM Resources, Homebrewing Abilities_.
You can use Restricted Abilities even if restricted in your current adventures.
You have +4 Focus.
<Hermeticism>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<Highmancy>.Effect:
Your chosen Mancy Talent triggers 3 times when it happens.
Whenever you deal 20 or more Damage with a Spell, regain 1 Mana for each 20 Damage just dealt.
You have +2 Focus and +2 Instinct.
<Highmancy>.Upgrade: All your other Spells become themed to the same element, but keep their original Damage Type. For example, if you chose fire, Frost Nova will now burst in cold, blue flames instead of ice.
<Highmancy>.Notes: For example, when you hit multiple Units with an Ability, you increase your Fire Damage by +3 instead of +1, or you gain +6 Cold Damage from Hydromancy when you Status Effect an Enemy. For Eldritchianism, your Spells have their ^Dice Upgraded^ 3 times.
<Highmancy>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
